title: Too small to be useful.
text: Too small to be useful.. Extremely small and shallow. Doesn’t fit much of anything. Easy enough to assemble. However when I moved it to a different room, the base fell off and I had to put it back on. I ended up giving it to my son to display all his clay creations. It works there and keeps his things elevated.
